question: Which suppliers do we hold the most stock from?
referenceSql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS units_on_hand FROM suppliers.suppliers s JOIN inventory.warehouse_inventory i ON i.supplier_id = s.supplier_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY units_on_hand DESC

question: How many units are on order from suppliers in each region?
referenceSql: SELECT s.region, COUNT(*) AS open_orders, SUM(p.qty_ordered) AS units_on_order FROM procurement.purchase_orders p JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY units_on_order DESC

question: Which in-transit purchase orders arrive first, and from which supplier and carrier?
referenceSql: SELECT p.po_id, p.sku, s.name AS supplier, h.carrier, h.eta_date FROM procurement.purchase_orders p JOIN suppliers.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN inventory.shipments h ON h.po_id = p.po_id WHERE p.status = 'IN_TRANSIT' ORDER BY h.eta_date

question: How many shipments does each carrier have?
referenceSql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS shipments FROM inventory.shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY shipments DESC

question: How much stock is in each warehouse?
referenceSql: SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(qty_on_hand) AS units FROM inventory.warehouse_inventory GROUP BY warehouse_id ORDER BY warehouse_id
